statement: Let Ω be a bounded domain in the mean plane with compact closure, and let a chart α as in Theorem 5.1 extend continuously to Ω. Suppose f ∈ C(Ω) ∩ C2(Ω), f ≤ Fβ ◦ α on ∂Ω, and, for every µ ∈ Ω and every supporting supergradient g there, Lf (µ) > g · Lα(µ) − 1. 39 Then f ≤ Fβ ◦ α throughout Ω. For the affine W chart, the analogous conclusion holds for Uγ when LW f > −γ.
